d:
Since the unlocking of blackwhip, Midoriya has doubled his training. To master his new quirk, he has been relying on his anger to control it, which has left him quite stressed... So being the loyal friend she is, Asui Tsuyu has volunteered ease his burden, by helping him carry some of this...load... he carries.
